name: executive-frame-learning-hub
description: Executive Frame Learning Hub: self directed subscription app at app.executiveframe.co.nz. Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Firebase, in the ef-client-hub project beside the Client Hub.

scripts.check: npm run test:unit && npm run contrast
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-learninghub --only firestore,storage "node --test tests/rules.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run contrast && npm run test:rules
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run check && firebase deploy --project ef-client-hub --only hosting:learning
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run test:unit && firebase deploy --project ef-client-hub --only functions:learning
